articles.title_en: On The Distributional Effects Of International Tariffs
articles.title_cn: 论国际关税的分配效应
articles.abstract_en: We provide a quantitative analysis of the distributional effects of the 2018 increase in tariffs by the United States and its major trading partners. We build a trade model with incomplete asset markets and households that are heterogeneous in their age, income, wealth, and labor skill. When tariff revenues are used to reduce distortionary taxes on consumption, labor, and capital income, the average welfare loss from the trade war is equivalent to a permanent 0.1% reduction in consumption. Much larger welfare losses are concentrated among retirees and low‐wealth households, whereas only wealthy households experience a welfare gain.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对2018年美国及其主要贸易伙伴提高关税的分配效应进行了定量分析。我们构建了一个具有不完整资产市场以及年龄、收入、财富和劳动技能异质性的家庭的贸易模型。当关税收入用于减少对消费、劳动和资本收入的扭曲性税收时，贸易战的平均福利损失相当于消费永久性减少0.1%。更大的福利损失集中在退休人员和低财富家庭，而只有富裕家庭才能获得福利收益。

articles.title_en: A Panel Clustering Approach To Analyzing Bubble Behavior
articles.title_cn: 面板聚类方法分析泡沫行为
articles.abstract_en: This study provides new mechanisms for identifying and estimating explosive bubbles in mixed‐root panel autoregressions with a latent group structure. A postclustering approach is employed that combines k‐means clustering with right‐tailed panel‐data testing. Uniform consistency of the k‐means algorithm is established. Pivotal null limit distributions of the tests are introduced. A new method is proposed to consistently estimate the number of groups. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed methods perform well in finite samples; and empirical applications of the proposed methods identify bubbles in the U.S. and Chinese housing markets and the U.S. stock market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究为具有潜在群组结构的混合根面板自回归中爆炸性泡沫的识别和估计提供了新机制。采用了一种后聚类方法，将k均值聚类与右尾面板数据检验相结合。建立了k均值算法的一致一致性。引入了检验的枢轴零极限分布。提出了一种新方法来一致估计群组数量。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的方法在有限样本中表现良好；所提出方法的实证应用识别了美国和中国的住房市场以及美国股市中的泡沫。

articles.abstract_en: The consequences of costly information acquisition for sovereign risk are explored in a quantitative sovereign default model. We identify information costs empirically using Bloomberg news‐heat data. The calibrated model microfounds heteroskedasticity in the country risk spread as measured by a novel metric we call the Crisis Volatility Ratio (CVR). Crises are endogenously more volatile because more information is acquired and priced. Recalibrated extant models do not generate CVRs in the empirical range, but ours does. Because effective risk tolerance depends on the information set, the model also suggests that risk premia fall with information costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个量化的主权违约模型中探讨了昂贵信息获取对主权风险的影响。我们利用彭博新闻热度数据实证识别了信息成本。校准后的模型为一种我们称之为危机波动率比（CVR）的新指标所衡量的国家风险溢价的异方差性提供了微观基础。危机内生地更具波动性，因为更多信息被获取并定价。重新校准的现有模型无法生成处于经验范围内的CVR，而我们的模型可以。由于有效风险承受能力取决于信息集，该模型还表明风险溢价随信息成本下降而降低。

articles.title_cn: 企业家-投资者信息设计
articles.abstract_en: I consider an environment in which an entrepreneur generates information about the quality of his project prior to contracting with an investor. The investor faces a moral‐hazard problem since the entrepreneur may divert the funding for private consumption. I find that the efficient amount of information is generated if and only if the bargaining power of the entrepreneur is high enough. I interpret this result in terms of investors' tightness, competitiveness, and generosity measures. I also show that the investor prefers not to have all the bargaining power when the project costs are high enough.
articles.abstract_cn: 我考虑一个环境，其中企业家在与投资者签订合同之前生成关于其项目质量的信息。投资者面临道德风险问题，因为企业家可能将资金挪用于私人消费。我发现，当且仅当企业家的议价能力足够高时，才会生成有效数量的信息。我根据投资者的紧张程度、竞争性和慷慨程度指标来解释这一结果。我还表明，当项目成本足够高时，投资者宁愿不拥有全部议价能力。

articles.title_en: Catchment Areas, Stratification, And Access To Better Schools
articles.title_cn: 学区划分、分层与优质学校入学机会
articles.abstract_en: School Choice provides students with the opportunity to attend better schools than those in their neighborhood. This is crucial for students from disadvantaged areas where schools may be of lower quality. Our theoretical model and numerical simulations show that the widely used Deferred Acceptance (DA) algorithm has limitations in providing access to better schools (ABS). When schools have varying levels of quality and when there are priorities linked to neighborhood schools, the DA algorithm experiences significant limitations in providing ABS. Top Trading Cycles, when compared to DA, offers greater ABS, particularly for disadvantaged students.
articles.abstract_cn: 学校选择为学生提供了就读比其所在社区更好的学校的机会。这对于来自学校质量可能较低的弱势地区的学生至关重要。我们的理论模型和数值模拟表明，广泛使用的延迟接受（DA）算法在提供优质学校入学机会（ABS）方面存在局限性。当学校质量参差不齐且存在与 neighborhood 学校相关的优先权时，DA 算法在提供 ABS 方面表现出显著局限性。与 DA 相比，顶级交易循环（TTC）提供了更大的 ABS，尤其是对弱势学生而言。

articles.title_en: Modeling Interregional Patient Mobility: Theory And Evidence From Spatially Explicit Data
articles.title_cn: 建模跨区域患者流动：来自空间显式数据的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: This article provides theory and evidence on the spatial determinants of regional patient flows. We develop a theoretical model that explains a patient's choice to consult a general practitioner by a measure of spatial accessibility. We empirically test this gravity‐type model using regional patient flows and detailed data on the spatial distribution of residents and physicians in Austria. Our measure of spatial accessibility is a crucial determinant of patient flows that substantially increases the explanatory power of regular gravity models. Counterfactual simulations show heterogeneous effects of exiting physicians on health‐care accessibility and patient mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于区域患者流动空间决定因素的理论和证据。我们开发了一个理论模型，通过空间可达性指标解释患者选择咨询全科医生的决策。我们使用奥地利区域患者流动以及居民和医生空间分布的详细数据，对该引力型模型进行了实证检验。我们的空间可达性指标是患者流动的关键决定因素，显著提高了常规引力模型的解释力。反事实模拟显示，医生退出对医疗保健可达性和患者流动具有异质性影响。

articles.abstract_en: Two types of interventions are commonly implemented in networks: characteristics interventions, which influence individuals' intrinsic incentives, and structural interventions, which target the social links among individuals. In this article, we provide a general framework to evaluate the distinct equilibrium effects of both types of interventions. We show that any structural intervention is outcome‐equivalent to an endogenously determined characteristics intervention. We present a wide range of applications of our theory, including evaluating a potential new link in a community, identifying the most wanted criminal(s) in delinquent networks, and determining whether a structural intervention improves certain welfare measures.
articles.abstract_cn: 网络中通常实施两种类型的干预：特征干预，影响个体的内在激励；以及结构性干预，针对个体之间的社会联系。在本文中，我们提供了一个通用框架来评估这两种干预措施的独特均衡效应。我们表明，任何结构性干预在结果上等同于一种内生决定的特征干预。我们展示了我们理论的广泛应用，包括评估社区中潜在的新联系、识别 delinquent 网络中最想要的罪犯，以及确定结构性干预是否改善某些福利指标。

articles.title_en: A Three‐State Rational Greater‐Fool Bubble Model With Intertemporal Consumption Smoothing
articles.title_cn: 一个具有跨期消费平滑的三状态理性更大傻瓜泡沫模型
articles.abstract_en: We construct a simple rational greater‐fool bubble model, where the motive for trade is intertemporal consumption smoothing. This yields an easy‐to‐understand bubble model with three states of the world, instead of the five required previously. Bubbles are more likely when asset sellers have profitable investment opportunities, but little wealth, so they sell shares in those opportunities to wealthier investors. “Bad sellers” then pretend to sell similar investment opportunities, creating potential bubble assets. Bubbles are possible even if alternative means of consumption smoothing are available. Also, antibubble policy can reduce the welfare of even the greater fools it is supposed to protect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个简单的理性更大傻瓜泡沫模型，其中交易动机是跨期消费平滑。这产生了一个易于理解的泡沫模型，具有三种世界状态，而不是之前所需的五种。当资产卖方拥有有利可图的投资机会但财富很少时，泡沫更可能发生，因此他们将那些机会的股份出售给更富有的投资者。然后，“坏卖方”假装出售类似的投资机会，创造潜在的泡沫资产。即使有其他消费平滑手段可用，泡沫也可能存在。此外，反泡沫政策甚至可能降低它本应保护的更大傻瓜的福利。

articles.title_en: Uk Inflation Dynamics Since The Thirteenth Century
articles.title_cn: 自十三世纪以来英国的通胀动态
articles.abstract_en: Historians have suggested that there were waves of inflation or price revolutions in the United Kingdom (and earlier England) in the 13th, 16th, and 18th centuries, prior to the ongoing inflation since 1935. We study retail price inflation since 1251 and model its dynamics. The model is an AR(n) but allows for gradually evolving or drifting parameters and stochastic volatility. The long‐horizon forecasts suggest only one inflation wave, that of the 20th century. We also use the model to measure inflation predictability and price‐level instability from the beginning of the sample and to provide measures of real interest rates since 1695.
articles.abstract_cn: 历史学家提出，在联合王国（以及更早的英格兰），于13、16和18世纪存在通胀浪潮或价格革命，早于自1935年以来持续的通胀。我们研究自1251年以来的零售价格通胀并对其动态进行建模。该模型为AR(n)模型，但允许参数逐渐演变或漂移以及随机波动率。长期预测表明仅存在一次通胀浪潮，即20世纪的那次。我们还使用该模型从样本开始时期衡量通胀可预测性和价格水平不稳定性，并提供自1695年以来的实际利率度量。

articles.abstract_en: This article quantifies the value of U.S. highways. We develop a multisector general equilibrium model with many locations in the United States (i.e., counties) and many countries. In the model, producers choose shipping routes subject to domestic and international trade costs, endogenous congestion, and port efficiency at international transshipment points. Applying the model, we find that removing the Interstate Highway System reduces real GDP by $421–$578 billion. The results highlight the gains from intersectoral and international trade as well as the role of domestic transportation infrastructure in shaping regional comparative advantage.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了美国高速公路的价值。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型，包含美国国内的许多地点（即县）和许多国家。在模型中，生产者在面临国内和国际贸易成本、内生拥堵以及国际转运点港口效率的情况下选择运输路线。应用该模型，我们发现移除州际公路系统将使实际GDP减少421亿至578亿美元。结果凸显了部门间和国际贸易的收益，以及国内交通基础设施在塑造区域比较优势中的作用。

articles.title_en: Optimal Payment Contracts In Trade Relationships
articles.title_cn: 贸易关系中的最优支付契约
articles.abstract_en: In buyer–seller relationships, offering trade credit to buyers fosters long‐term collaboration but seller provision varies systematically as relationships evolve. We study the optimal provision dynamics of trade credit when the seller's information about the buyer is incomplete. We show how the interaction of self‐enforcing relational contracts and formal contracts determines optimal payment contract choice. We find that payment contracts can be interpreted as screening technologies and imply distinct learning opportunities about the buyer's type. In line with empirical evidence, the model predicts that all transitions between payment terms lead to seller trade credit provision in the long run.
articles.abstract_cn: 在买方-卖方关系中，向买方提供贸易信贷有助于促进长期合作，但卖方的提供会随着关系的发展而系统性变化。我们研究了当卖方对买方的信息不完全时，贸易信贷的最优提供动态。我们展示了自我执行的关系契约与正式契约的相互作用如何决定最优支付契约选择。我们发现，支付契约可以被解释为筛选技术，并意味着关于买方类型的独特学习机会。与经验证据一致，该模型预测，支付条款之间的所有转换最终都会导致卖方在长期内提供贸易信贷。

articles.title_en: Learning And Evidence In Insurance Markets
articles.title_cn: 保险市场中的学习与证据
articles.abstract_en: I analyze a model of monopoly insurance contracting where the consumer has access to endogenous, costly evidence of his risk type. I characterize when the consumer is worse off if the insurer is allowed to condition contracts on evidence and when the ability to contract on evidence leads to a Pareto improvement. I compare the results to an analogous setting with perfect competition: Under perfect competition, when evidence acquisition costs are low, the ability to contract on evidence is always Pareto improving. For intermediate costs, I uncover a new source of unraveling.
articles.abstract_cn: 我分析了一个垄断保险合约模型，其中消费者可以获得关于其风险类型的内生的、有成本的证据。我刻画了在何种情况下，如果允许保险公司根据证据来制定合约，消费者的境况会变得更差，以及何时基于证据的合约能力会导致帕累托改进。我将结果与一个完全竞争的类似环境进行比较：在完全竞争下，当证据获取成本较低时，基于证据的合约能力总是帕累托改进的。对于中等成本，我发现了新的拆解来源。

articles.title_en: Credit Constraints, Endogenous Innovations, And Price Setting In International Trade
articles.title_cn: 国际贸易中的信贷约束、内生创新与价格设定
articles.abstract_en: This article analyzes the role of credit frictions in a trade model where producers differ in their capabilities to conduct process and quality innovations and require external finance for investments. Accounting for cost‐based and quality‐based sorting of firms in a unified framework allows us to demonstrate that the reactions of prices and commonly used productivity measures do not necessarily reflect welfare implications. Credit frictions lead to distortions through aggravated access to finance and endogenous price adjustments so that the responses of quantity‐based and revenue‐based productivity differ substantially. In counterfactual scenarios, we show that these differential effects are quantitatively important.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个贸易模型中分析了信贷摩擦的作用，其中生产者在其进行工艺创新和质量创新的能力上存在差异，并且需要外部融资来进行投资。在一个统一的框架中考虑基于成本和基于质量的企业分类，使我们能够证明价格和常用生产率指标的反应不一定反映福利含义。信贷摩擦通过加剧融资困难和内生价格调整导致扭曲，使得基于数量和基于收入的生产率的反应存在显著差异。在反事实情景中，我们表明这些差异效应在数量上是重要的。
